description: This PHP script initializes and populates multiple database tables related to a recruitment module, including candidates, vacancies, job titles, and related history and attachments. It performs database setup tasks such as truncating tables, inserting data, and updating unique IDs, mainly for data seeding or testing purposes.

methods.name: truncateTables
methods.description: Clears relevant recruitment tables in the database to prepare for fresh data insertion.

methods.name: addJobTitles
methods.description: Inserts predefined job titles into the database and updates the unique ID counter.

methods.name: addJobVacancies
methods.description: Creates and inserts multiple job vacancy entries with dynamically generated descriptions and timestamps.

methods.name: addCandidates
methods.description: Populates candidate details, CVs, vacancy applications, and history, using predefined name lists and related data files.

methods.name: display
methods.description: A logging function intended to output or log the input value; currently commented out.

methods.name: checkQueryResult
methods.description: Checks result of a database query; performs rollback if the query fails.

methods.name: getCandidateQPartial
methods.description: Generates a portion of the SQL insert statement for candidate data.

methods.name: getCvQPartial
methods.description: Generates a part of SQL insert statement for candidate CV attachments.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyQPartial
methods.description: Builds SQL insert segment for candidate-vacancy relation.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryQPartial
methods.description: Creates SQL insert portion for candidate application and history records.
